title: Analyzing Social Exchange Motives With Theory-Driven Data and Machine Learning

items.verbatim_quote: The prediction of “why” based intent using interaction traces like the clickstream and interaction network, however, remains relatively unexplored.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，利用点击流和交互网络等交互痕迹来预测“为什么”类意图（即动机）的研究相对未被探索。

items.verbatim_quote: While Bolle et al. [28] analyzed motives in a game context that relied on explicitly defined reward values, the open social exchange used in our study has no defined reward for actions. Also, there was no indication of whether the utility function can predict the players’ ‘unseen’ motives.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，Bolle等人的研究依赖于明确定义的奖励值，而本研究使用的开放社会交换没有定义奖励；此外，尚不清楚效用函数能否预测玩家“未见的”动机。

items.verbatim_quote: This is an oversimplification because each allocation may be informed by multiple motives.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，将每次分配视为仅由单一动机驱动是一种过度简化，因为每次分配可能受到多种动机的影响。

items.verbatim_quote: While questionnaires and surveys have been traditional tools for investigating motives, they have inherent self-report biases and are expensive and time-consuming, particularly in repeated interactions where motives evolve over time.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评传统问卷和调查方法存在自我报告偏差，且在动机随时间演变的重复互动中成本高、耗时。
items.target_of_critique: traditional questionnaire and survey methods for investigating motives

items.verbatim_quote: While Bolle et al. [28] analyzed motives in a game context that relied on explicitly defined reward values, the open social exchange used in our study has no defined reward for actions. Also, there was no indication of whether the utility function can predict the players’ ‘unseen’ motives.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评Bolle等人的研究依赖于明确定义的奖励值，且未表明效用函数能否预测未见的动机。

items.verbatim_quote: a critique that can be made of this study is whether the ground truth is accurate. Self-reporting introduces inherent biases, including impression management, such as faking and lying [68]. This raised the question: why should we place trust in individuals’ self-disclosures? Consequently, self-reporting does not serve as a benchmark for accurately identifying motives. In our study, we combined previous moves and the knowledge of well-established theories on social exchanges to identify motives signaled by the recipient’s identity. While this approach mitigated the trust issues associated with self-reporting, it introduced a dependency on, and necessitated trust in, psychological theories about motives in social exchanges.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，本研究对动机的识别依赖于社会交换理论，这引入了对心理学理论的依赖和信任问题，即动机的“真实值”可能不准确。

items.verbatim_quote: An improvement would be to incorporate a search strategy that penalizes the algorithm when it is biased toward a class.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来改进C-HMM算法，加入一种搜索策略，当算法偏向某一类别时对其进行惩罚，以缓解类别不平衡的影响。
items.methodological_detail_cn: 改进C-HMM算法，加入惩罚偏向某一类别的搜索策略。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: Our model can be extended to nudging prosocial behavior in human-agent collaborations.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者提出，他们的模型可以扩展到在人机协作中助推亲社会行为。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: The insights provided by theories on social exchange behaviors help predict motives in the experimental game. Conversely, our approach can help social scientists identify the factors that predict motives.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，社会交换行为理论为预测实验游戏中的动机提供了洞见，而他们的机器学习方法反过来可以帮助社会科学家识别预测动机的因素。
raw_item.current_theoretical_limit_cn: 当前社会交换理论提供了动机预测的洞见，但尚未系统识别哪些因素最能预测动机。
raw_item.proposed_theoretical_move_cn: 利用机器学习方法识别预测社会交换动机的关键因素，从而扩展理论对动机预测因素的理解。
raw_item.relationship_or_prediction_to_test_cn: 检验哪些因素（如地位、内群体关系等）是预测社会交换动机的最重要因素。
